title: Create WTP-aware Codex planning skill
description:
Create a new reusable wtp-codex-planning skill that gives Codex a planning workflow equivalent in quality and structure to its native planning skill, but ends with an explicit handoff into WTP tasks. First inspect the installed/native Codex planning skill and existing repository skills (especially task-management, setup-wtp, and codex-wtp-loop) so terminology, instructions, command syntax, safety rules, and style are compatible; do not copy unavailable/internal instructions verbatim.

The skill must direct the agent to research the workspace, ask only decision-critical clarification questions via ask_user_questions (using the current supported equivalent if the tool is renamed), and produce a complete implementation plan with scope, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, verification, and a sensible task breakdown. Before presenting the final WTP task proposal, it must ask the user for a target-model assignment distribution: which enabled models to use and percentages that sum to 100%, with a clear default or explicit correction loop for invalid/incomplete input. Explain that distribution is a target across the generated tasks, while individual assignments may deviate only when task complexity/risks are documented.

At plan completion, present an editable numbered proposal of WTP tasks rather than requiring the user to skip plan mode, disable it, and ask again. Each proposed task must have a concise title, self-contained implementation detail, acceptance/verification expectations, estimate, priority, lane/grouping metadata when supported, dependencies, and a model assignment derived from the requested distribution. Display a distribution summary/count and flag deviations.

The skill must offer a user-controlled decision point with three outcomes: amend the plan/tasks (collect changes and regenerate the proposal), refuse/cancel (create nothing), or task up/approve (create the WTP tasks). Never create or mutate WTP tasks until explicit approval. On approval, create tasks using canonical WTP commands/API, preserve dependency ordering/IDs, report the created task IDs and model distribution, and handle partial failure safely by reporting exactly what was created and what remains. Include guidance for dry-run/preview where available.

Keep this as a skill addition, not a change to Codex built-in plan mode. Update any relevant skill documentation/registry/validators and add focused tests or contract checks that ensure required prompts, distribution validation, the amend/refuse/approve gate, no-write-before-approval, and generated task metadata are all covered. Validate the skill and run relevant repository checks.
